name: SEACOR Marine Holdings Inc.
summary: SEACOR Marine Holdings Inc. provides marine and support transportation services to offshore energy facilities worldwide. The company engages in the operation and management of a fleet of offshore support vessels that deliver cargo and personnel to offshore installations, including offshore wind farms; assisting in offshore operations for production and storage facilities; and carrying and launching of equipment used underwater in drilling and well installation, maintenance, inspection and repair. It also provides construction, well work-over, offshore wind farm installation and decommissioning support services; emergency response services; and accommodations for technicians and specialists. …
